summary: Verified WhatsApp module end-to-end (mock driver). Backend pytest suite (10/10 passing) covers inbox conversations shape+filters, simulate-inbound, thread/reply within 24h window, window enforcement (text=422, template=200 after tinker sets last_inbound_at -30h), mark-read/assign/toggle, auto-replies CRUD + firing on keyword 'price', broadcasts create+send (recipients count + sent/failed/total + duplicate-send 422), Meta webhook GET verify (200 with challenge, 403 wrong token), Meta webhook POST inbound auto-creates lead+conversation, STOP opt-out ack. RBAC verified: partner (no leads.view) -> 403 on /whatsapp/conversations; Sales Exec (no config.manage) -> 403 on /whatsapp/broadcasts and /whatsapp/auto-replies but 200 on /whatsapp/conversations. Frontend UI verified as priya: nav-inbox loads wa-conv-list with wa-conv-{id}, thread renders (wa-thread/wa-messages), reply input+send work, wa-simulate opens modal with wa-sim-input/wa-sim-send and injects inbound (auto-reply fired on 'price' visible as reply), wa-assign present, nav-broadcasts and nav-waAutomations render tables with existing entries. Frontend RBAC: Sales Exec (rahul) sees nav-inbox=1, nav-broadcasts=0, nav-waAutomations=0 (correct). Channel Partner sees only Partner Portal (no whatsapp nav).

minor.issue: When lead has whatsapp_opt_out/do_not_contact, endpoint returns HTTP 500 with body 'Contact has opted out / is do-not-contact.' instead of a proper 4xx (422 or 409). Consent guard exception is not mapped to a validation response. Reproduce: simulate-inbound against a lead previously opted out via STOP webhook.

integration_issues.flow: Send reply from inbox after clicking first conversation
integration_issues.issue: Observed one 422 in console when sending on a conversation that was aged beyond the 24h window from prior tests. Behavior is correct (window enforcement) but the wa-window-banner + disabled send state was not visually verified for the aged conversation — worth a spot check.

action_items: Map InboxService consent guard exception (opted-out / do-not-contact) to HTTP 422 in WhatsAppInboxController::simulateInbound to avoid 500s. Currently surfaces as generic 500 with descriptive message.
critical_code_review_comments: Consent-guard should throw a ValidationException (or return 422) rather than a generic exception that Laravel renders as 500.
Response shapes are inconsistent across endpoints: auto-reply store returns {rule:{...}}, broadcasts likely {broadcast:{...}}, conversations returns flat keys. Consider standardising resource keys.
Simulate-inbound is powerful test tool — ensure it is either gated behind config.manage or a debug env flag before production.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/tests/whatsapp_test.py (pytest). Requires Laravel dev server on 127.0.0.1:8000 (not REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Uses `php artisan tinker --execute` for time travel on last_inbound_at (see test_window_enforcement). The auto-reply store response uses key 'rule' (not 'auto_reply'). Simulate-inbound against an opted-out lead currently returns 500 — pick a lead where whatsapp_opt_out=false (fixture already does).
rca of the issue: Only minor issue: 500 on simulate-inbound for opted-out lead. RCA: InboxService::recordInbound (or upstream in simulateInbound) throws a runtime exception on consent block; controller does not catch and convert to 422. Fix: wrap in try/catch mapping to ValidationException::withMessages(['lead'=>'...'])->status(422), or use abort(422, '...').
